title: Nvidia warns: Lack of computing power threatens Europe’s competitiveness in artificial intelligence
hook_text: Europe faces an AI computing crisis
script:
Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang warns Europe risks falling behind in AI.
The continent currently lacks the local computing power to compete globally.
Huang states that AI is vital for Europe to maintain its industrial strength.
Europe trails the United States in deploying the necessary AI infrastructure.
Building sovereign AI capacity is essential for the region's future economic success.
Without more localized data centers, Europe relies heavily on external hardware providers.
Can Europe build enough infrastructure to keep its AI industry independent?
